summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance on node1. Verified all scopes and interfaces remain hardened after a successful reboot.
actions_performed: Disabled accept_redirects and accept_source_route for all, default, ens2, and lo scopes.
Applied the settings live and verified IPv4 connectivity remained healthy.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified systemd-sysctl, SSH, persistent configuration, live kernel values, addresses, and routes recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
evidence.summary: The persistent sysctl file was installed and applied. Before and after reboot, all/default/ens2/lo reported accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 0d49f077-ed5b-479a-b08e-ec4392d89c52; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID a30092e0-dc8d-48de-a1bc-cf71940b0044; systemd-sysctl and SSH were active, hardened values persisted, ens2 was up, and the default route recovered.
